title.purpose: Drawers, empty states, and meaningful subviews.

body.purpose: Decision text, explanations, and report previews.

label.purpose: Controls, compact status, and metadata headings.

shadows.name: raised-workspace
shadows.purpose: Drawers and popovers that physically overlap active content.

motion.name: state-responsive
motion.purpose: Hover, selection, and state feedback only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single deliberate action in an action group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, var(--foreground)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A bounded secondary action with quiet contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input) 30%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action inside an already structured surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: A clearly separate discard or irreversible action.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 25%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact field for local configuration and queue filters.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field { height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 0.625rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font: inherit; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--ring); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Queue and Applications remain the only primary destinations.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-nav-item { padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-bottom-color: var(--primary); color: var(--foreground); }

components.name: State Badge
components.description: A display-only preparation or browser state label.
components.css: .ds-state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 1.5rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: HereForWork should feel like a well-prepared desk at the start of a focused work session. The interface is calm, capable, and direct. Operational complexity stays behind the surface; the next meaningful decision remains obvious without pressure, celebration, or false certainty.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained, light-first surfaces with a single Signal Lime accent.
Direct lists and dividers instead of repeated card grids.
Compact, tactile controls with explicit states and generous focus treatment.
Visible uncertainty and progress expressed through text, not color alone.
Responsive state motion only, never decorative choreography.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Lime occupies no more than ten percent of a normal working surface. If several controls compete in Lime, the hierarchy is wrong.

rules.name: The No Pure Neutral Rule
rules.body: Canvas, surfaces, and ink remain subtly cool-tinted. Pure white and pure black are forbidden.

rules.name: The Working Voice Rule
rules.body: Interface labels are short and literal. Typography must never turn an operational screen into a marketing page.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Rows, groups, and sections remain unshadowed. If every section looks lifted, nothing has priority.

dos: Do search the shadcn registry before implementing every new component.
Do keep one obvious primary action in each action group.
Do keep uncertainty, blockers, and skipped work visible in plain language.
Do use semantic lists, headings, buttons, fields, and progress elements with complete keyboard behavior.
Do use Signal Lime sparingly against Mist surfaces and verify WCAG 2.2 AA contrast for every text pairing.
Do preserve the user's physical Submit decision and every other HereForWork safety boundary.
donts: Don't copy mass auto-apply products that treat application count as the primary success metric.
Don't create interfaces that hide blockers or express uncertain fit as confident fact.
Don't add gamification that adds pressure to an already stressful search.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, hero-metric layouts, or identical card grids.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders or shadows on ordinary rows and sections.
Don't create a component from scratch when the shadcn registry already provides the required semantics.
Don't use a modal as the first solution when inline disclosure, a drawer, or progressive reveal can preserve context.
